 Friday's Market Volatility Spike May Have Gone Too Far
 Oct 18, 2026, 9:55 AM ET S&P 500 Futures (SPX) , NDX , SPY , IVV , VOO , QQQ , DIA , IWM , SP500 , DJI 15 Comments 1 Like Mott Capital Management Investing Group Leader Follow Summary
 Friday's sell-off pushed VIX metrics sharply higher.
 Implied volatility is likely to fall as the week begins.
 Technical and options gamma offer market support.
 Vigilance remains crucial beneath the index surface.
 Looking for a helping hand in the market? Members of Reading The Markets get exclusive ideas and guidance to navigate any climate. Learn More » 
 DKosig/iStock via Getty Images
 Friday's sell-off may have gone a bit too far, at least based on implied volatility metrics, which suggest the VIX may be ahead of itself. That suggests the range-bound market we've seen since June will likely stay that
